title: Audit selected SDK user assignment and input blocking
goal: Exercise the actual selected SDK input-system module above the verified SDL3 provider, distinguishing real virtual-device routing from SDK user-0 fallback and documenting the ownership integration boundary before physical/title input admission.
acceptance: Load the real verified input-system and SDL3 provider modules through versioned interfaces, with original owned host context, private configuration and exact SDK/source/compiler/loaded-library identities; embed no SDK module or guest implementation

Use four distinguishable original SDL virtual devices to verify independent SDK user readings, capability/vibration routing, unchanged/changed packet observations and hotplug behavior without deriving player identities from enumeration order
Exercise nested UI input blocking/restoration, documented no-device user-0 fallback, explicit shared-pad mode and invalid users; never count a successful neutral fallback as four connected players

Retain baseline failures and exact wrong-routing/incomplete-process rejection; document SDK automatic assignment versus the MW3-080 explicit ownership contract and split any demonstrated SDK/shared/guest integration repair before modifying it
validation: Run original isolated/repeated device-order and lifecycle cases on native Windows and Linux/WSL with supported host and participating-core sanitizers, preserving exact logs/source/configuration/artifact identities

Require actual loaded input-system/provider/SDL/base identities, bounded owned dispatcher/handle cleanup and exact complete result records; reject deliberate wrong routing, stale/duplicate/partial results, wrong libraries and late children
Run public game-free checks and report physical controllers, independent Linux hardware, guest services and actual MW3 input unexecuted; this investigation cannot complete MW3-083 or MW3-012
size: bounded SDK user-routing investigation; no runtime or SDK repair
